item.text: The failures cluster into a few general defects rather than isolated cases: keyword boolean operators are not in the expression precedence table, function-call generator arguments are being evaluated as one unsupported builtin shape, and several core arithmetic/string builtins are absent. I’m correcting those shared paths now, including jq’s remainder semantics and function-scope behavior.
